title: Differential Fixture (INTERFACE v1.2)
description: Fixture object consumed by scripts/differential_parity.py. Mirrors /tmp/qubit-differential/INTERFACE.md (v1.2). A fixture has EITHER a command block (CLI argv) or a request block; the unused one may be null. v1.2 adds transport, base_url_ref, auth, sequence, events_expected and persisted_state_schema (all optional). v1.3 adds the voice transport and the optional voice fields utterance, expected_operation, expected_args, confirmation_required, cancel_semantics, expiry_seconds and replay_protection (all optional; none is required, matching the runner).

env.description: Env var NAMES mapped to $NAME / env:NAME references only. Never a secret value.

transport.description: INTERFACE v1.2 transport kind for a request fixture. v1.3 adds voice for utterance-driven fixtures.

utterance.description: Optional. Voice input for a voice fixture: the spoken/text utterance that must resolve to expected_operation. Never a secret.

expected_operation.description: Optional. Canonical operation the utterance is expected to resolve to; must match the CLI/dashboard operation.

expected_args.description: Optional. Canonical arguments the resolved operation is expected to carry.

confirmation_required.description: Optional. True when the resolved operation must stage in the shared confirmation journal before it can execute.

cancel_semantics.description: Optional. Declared cancel behavior for a confirm-required voice operation (for example that cancel/deny executes nothing).

expiry_seconds.description: Optional. Lifetime in seconds of a staged voice confirmation before it expires.

replay_protection.description: Optional. Replay-protection declaration for a voice operation (single-use utterance/confirmation token).

events_expected.description: INTERFACE v1.2 expected event stream, in declared server order.

read_only.description: Optional. True when this fixture only reads canonical state and performs no state-changing operation. Defaults to false when absent.

state_changing.description: Optional. True when executing this fixture mutates persistent/canonical state. Defaults to false when absent.

allow_state_changing.description: Optional runner opt-in. When true the runner is permitted to execute a state_changing fixture; when false/absent a state_changing row is skipped rather than executed.

references.description: Optional real tri-way upstream invocations. Each key is an upstream project (hermes|openclaw); each value is a reference spec run through that project's binary/transport. Absent references mean the row is OPERATOR_ONLY, never PASS.

envRef.description: Environment reference ($NAME, ${NAME} or env:NAME). Never the secret value.

envName.description: Environment variable NAME (bare, $NAME, ${NAME} or env:NAME). Never the variable's value.

stepSpec.description: One step of a v1.2 sequence: a CLI/HTTP/SSE/WS/RPC step spec.

referenceSpec.description: One real upstream reference invocation (INTERFACE v1.2). Either a CLI argv spec (kind:cli + argv) or a transport spec (kind/transport + request/path/messages/params). env_ref/bin_ref name the environment variables that resolve the project binary and env; the VALUES never appear in the fixture. No single key is required because the runner derives the kind from argv/request/path.

env.description: Env var NAMES mapped to $NAME / env:NAME references only. Never a secret value.

env_ref.description: Name of the env var holding this reference's environment (never the value).

bin_ref.description: Name of the env var resolving this reference's binary/URL (never the value).

request.description: Nested transport request; falls back to this spec's own method/path/headers/body/messages.

sequence.description: Multi-step handshake/reconnect steps for this reference.

nondeterministic.description: Optional. When true the reference reports a runtime-selected backend and cannot be pinned; the runner still executes it for evidence but never derives an upstream_result_hash or a PASS from its payload. Defaults to false when absent.

path.description: Upstream file:line, or null when unknown

mapping_status.description: UNVERIFIED means no pinned-clone file:line was confirmed; the runner must classify dependent rows OPEN.
